pattern_rationale: The PAS emits real-time HL7 v2 event messages (ADT^A01, ADT^A03, ADT^A04) written as files. Ingesting and parsing these message events sequentially to construct and update Patient and Encounter FHIR resources fits the message feed ingest pattern.

alternatives_considered.why_not: The source consists of discrete event-based HL7 v2 messages rather than batch extract CSV/XML file dumps requiring full snapshot deduplication.
The PAS system does not provide an HTTP API endpoint; it outputs file-based HL7 v2 ADT messages.
Direct SQL read access to the PAS database is not available; data is pushed via HL7 file drop.

sync.detail: File watcher on specified input directory monitoring for incoming *.hl7 files, processing messages upon file creation.

field_map.transform: Parse HL7 date YYYYMMDD to FHIR date YYYY-MM-DD

resources.merge_rule: Update existing Patient resource identified by PID.3.1 with latest demographics on each incoming ADT message.

field_map.transform: If PV1.45 is present and populated set 'finished', else set 'in-progress'
Parse HL7 timestamp YYYYMMDDHHMMSS to ISO-8601 UTC string YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
Parse HL7 timestamp YYYYMMDDHHMMSS to ISO-8601 UTC string YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ; omit if missing

Map ward/clinic code ('CARD3' -> 'Cardiology Ward 3', 'CLINIC3' -> 'Outpatient Clinic 3', 'ED' -> 'Emergency Department', 'MED1' -> 'Medical Ward 1', 'OPD1' -> 'Outpatient Department 1', 'OPD2' -> 'Outpatient Department 2', 'SURG2' -> 'Surgical Ward 2') or pass raw text if unmapped

resources.merge_rule: Merge events sharing PV1.19. ADT^A01/A04 initializes encounter (in-progress); ADT^A03 sets discharge time PV1.45 and marks status as finished.

risks: Out-of-order file processing could cause an ADT^A03 (Discharge) to be ingested before ADT^A01 (Admit), overwriting final encounter state.
Timezone naive timestamps (YYYYMMDDHHMMSS) parsed as UTC may lead to off-by-hours errors if events occurred in local Europe/Dublin time.
File extension mismatch (.qd6 vs .hl7) could cause the file watcher to ignore incoming message drops.
human_review_points: Confirm whether naive timestamps should be explicitly interpreted as Europe/Dublin timezone instead of default UTC 'Z'.
Confirm file naming pattern and extension (.hl7 vs .qd6) used by the source system.
Define message archiving and deletion strategy after file ingestion to prevent re-processing.
